import asyncio,gc; from pathlib import Path; from common import write_json; from dank_retry_profile import measure
async def run():
    rows=[]
    for index in range(240):
        row=await measure(64,16,128*1024,False)
        row.update(round=index+1,gc_counts=gc.get_count(),gc_stats=gc.get_stats())
        rows.append(row)
    assert all(row["attempts"]==1088 and row["pending_tasks"]==129 for row in rows)
    write_json(Path("/reports/turnover.json"),{"same_process":True,"forced_collection":False,"timings_are_diagnostic":True,"rows":rows})
asyncio.run(run())
